paper_id: Tuning adaptive computations for the performance improvement of applications in JEE server
title: Tuning adaptive computations for the performance improvement of applications in JEE server
venue: The Brazilian Computer Society (Middleware '10 Best Workshop Papers)
motivation: JEE服务器的自适应计算消耗CPU/内存,与业务争抢资源,重负载下性能下降
problem_framing: 资源有限竞争环境下,如何在自适应计算与业务功能间动态分配资源
key_insight: 自适应计算可按 autonomic level 细粒度降级(S3→S0)而非粗暴启停,实现灵活的资源权衡
method_signature: 基于MAPE控制环的AC层级调优模型,设计CLAT等算法动态升降AC层级控制资源消耗
evaluation_criteria: ECperf和RUBiS基准的吞吐量、90%响应时间、成功请求数
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Markov预测调度开销抵消调优效果,实验结果不够好
evidence_for_taste: runtime overhead brought about by prediction will offset the tuning effects
such possibility that an AC never wants its level to be tuned
resource-hungry algorithms should not be used
thinking_moves: 类比OS进程调度设计AC调优算法,但指出AC有多状态(S0-S3)而非仅有启停
以AC maturity和gain value推断优先级,而非精确建模
承认Markov预测方案不work后转投简单有效的调度算法
聚焦高负载场景下的资源竞争问题,低负载则让AC全速运行
